answer: Price new identities on a burn curve: each registration burns a fee that doubles whenever signups in the last 24 hours exceed a quota, then decays back over a day. A farmer launching a voyage of 1,000 keys pushes the fee to its zenith and pays exponentially more per key, while a lone newcomer arriving on a quiet day pays almost nothing. Since the fee is burned, not paid to anyone, no island of colluders can recycle it among themselves.
